verdict.rationale: Automatic cross-session memory is a fair question for a coding agent, but nothing in the evidence pack shows Copilot building or recalling memory across sessions on its own. The closest items cover other things: docs-9 describes a manually curated shared knowledge source from docs and repositories, and docs-14 describes a control page for switching between agent sessions. Neither is automatic memory.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
